title: Incorrect package name in __getattr__
detail: The __getattr__ implementation returns the version of the 'werkzeug' package instead of 'jinja2', causing incorrect behavior when accessing __version__.
note: A real bug in the merged PR: __version__ returned werkzeug's version; fixed later in pallets/jinja@9c11dd6.

title: Incorrect control‑character width handling
detail: The condition lacks parentheses and does not explicitly check for codepoint 0 (NUL) or 0x07F (DEL). As written, codepoint 0 is treated as False and codepoint 0x07F is not caught, so these control characters incorrectly fall through to the table lookup and may report a width of 1. This breaks the test that expects width 0 for all non‑printable characters.
note: Says DEL (0x7F) isn't caught and may get a width of 1, which is the planted boundary.

title: Returning negative width from table
detail: The table can contain a width of -1 to indicate a zero‑width character. The original code returned 0 in that case, but the new code returns the raw width, so a character that should be zero‑width will now return -1, causing downstream calculations to be incorrect.
